name: SpotLite360 IOT Solutions, Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Spotlite360 Technologies, Inc. is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider with operations spanning Canada and the United States. The company offers its proprietary cloud-based platform, Spotlite360, which delivers robust capabilities for supply chain execution, detailed tracing, real-time tracking, and sustainability management. This advanced solution is tailored for large-scale businesses in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, logistics, and agricultural sectors. The organization was established in 2014.
